command_summary: LAM-20K, Multiface E001 frame 000102 camera 400017, save_img=true, save_ply=true, test_sample=true, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1.
decision: G42 proves LAM can export canonical Gaussian PLY, per-frame Gaussian PLYs, PNG frames, and mesh OBJs locally. It still does not prove reconstruction quality because the exported renders use LAM motion cameras, not held-out Multiface cameras, and the coordinate relation to GT geometry remains unvalidated.
environment_notes: A direct env-python command failed because torch was missing from base Python.
A second direct command reached LAM but nvdiffrast JIT failed because ninja was not on PATH.
The passing run used conda activate lam, env124.sh, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1, and test_sample=true.

manual_visual_audit: PASS_LOCAL_EXPORT_ONLY. The private frame sheet shows a coherent animated head and exported frames, but it still has green color cast, blurred shoulder/neck support, and background residuals. These frames are not Multiface held-out camera renders.
purpose: Verify whether the learned-prior LAM route can export frames and geometry-like artifacts that could become inputs to a later held-out camera or geometry metric adapter.
